✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I believe this Clash is short, fun, and would create a competitive challenge for multiple people. This Clash is not the most unique which is a downside as this Clash is similar to beginner programming exercises, however, it is also not too commonly seen in the Clashes I have played. This would make for a nice change of pace. Hardcoding is easily doable on this Clash, however, it would not be efficient at all, by time or bytes.

Title
* How does the title "Maya Temple" relate to the task?

Goal
* While it's important to describe the required output precisely, it's generally better to avoid using formulas when they aren't necessary. Please rewrite this section as follows:

• The pyramid has [[N]] lines.
• The first line contains a single [[N]].
• Each following line adds one [[N]] to both the left and right sides of the previous line, making it two digits wider.
• Add leading spaces so that the pyramid is centered.
• Do not print any trailing spaces.

Output
* Please rewrite this section as:

<<[[N]] lines:>> One line of the numeric pyramid of size [[N]].

Constraints
* Please change 100 to 9, since the second constraint also specifies that N is a single digit.

* Please remove the final constraint. It's a requirement of the output format rather than a constraint on the input.

Cases
* Example (Test 1): Please change N to 2.

* Mini-Pyri (Validator 3): Please change N to 6.

* Please add a new pair of cases where N = 1 in both the test and the validator.

Thanks.

Yes, just two more changes:

Goal
* Please delete "This creates a left‑aligned pyramid that grows by two characters on each line."

Constraints
* Please remove the second constraint.

Then you may consider switching the state of the contribution to Ready.

Thanks.
Yes. Optionally update the name of the validator where N = 6. In any case, you may consider switching the status to Ready.
